description: Guidelines for traveling with cigarettes in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Cigarettes are allowed in carry-on baggage. Smoking is prohibited on board the aircraft.

checkedBag.reason: Cigarettes are allowed in checked baggage.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring cigarettes on a plane?

Singapore.reason: Singapore has NO duty-free concession for cigarettes. You MUST declare even a single pack at customs and pay excise duties (SDPC mark required for local sale).

Germany.reason: 200 cigarettes duty-free allowance for non-EU travelers over age 17.

travelTips: Cigarettes are allowed in carry-on baggage. Smoking is prohibited on board the aircraft.

faq.question: Is cigarettes allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Cigarettes is allowed in carry-on luggage. Cigarettes are allowed in carry-on baggage. Smoking is prohibited on board the aircraft.

faq.question: Can you pack cigarettes in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Cigarettes is allowed in checked bags. Cigarettes are allowed in checked baggage.

faq.question: Can I bring cigarettes to Singapore?
faq.answer: Singapore allows you to bring duty-paid cigarettes, but there is ZERO duty-free allowance. You must declare every pack at the Red Channel at Changi Airport and pay tax. E-cigarettes are strictly banned.

faq.question: What is Lufthansa cigarette allowance?
faq.answer: For travelers arriving in Germany from outside the EU on Lufthansa, the duty-free allowance is 200 cigarettes (or 50 cigars) for passengers aged 17 and older.
